West Bengal CM announces waiver of application fees for gov job examinations 
17.11.2026 
 Last Updated on November 17, 2026 11:06 pm by INDIAN AWAAZ 
 West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari has announced a complete waiver of application fees for all competitive examinations for government jobs in the state.
 Addressing a job fair organised by the district police in Midnapore yesterday, he said the decision would ease the financial burden on job aspirants, particularly those belonging to economically weaker sections.
 The Chief Minister also announced two new initiatives – Bharosa Yojana to provide financial assistance to unemployed youth and Bhagini Nivedita Yojana to support girls pursuing higher education. The latter scheme will be launched in January next year, offering assistance of up to fifty thousand rupees over three years to eligible students.
